lines.zh: 奶油色的皮在阳光下反光
lines.en: My cream hide shines in the sun.
Four hooves press the soft plain grass.
My tail swishes the flies away.
I amble north along the field edge.
Head down, two steps, one more bite.

lines.zh: 脖子上的铃铛没响，我走得轻
lines.en: No bell on me. I walk softly.
A little mud clings to my pale coat.
I skirt the freshly turned soil.
I walk abreast with another cow.
Grass tips brush past my muzzle.
Not fast, but I never lose my way.

lines.zh: 影子在草地上拉成一条
lines.en: My shadow stretches into a line.
Sniffing the green smell in the wind.
My hoofprints fall round and even.
I spot a pond and change course.
A butterfly lands on my back.
Chewing my cud, eyes half shut.
Standing still by the fence.
I rub my horn against a post.
My ears swivel two directions at once.
I let out a long, soft snort.
Halfway through a mouthful, I stop.
My tail hangs and sways slowly.

lines.zh: 皮肤上有一块奶油色的斑
lines.en: A pale cream patch marks my flank.
I dip my head and lick my foreleg.
Comfortable now, I stop shifting.

lines.zh: 远处有牛叫，我应了一声
lines.en: A cow calls far off and I answer.
I rest my forehead on the rail.

lines.zh: 阳光把我的毛晒得发暖
lines.en: Sunlight warms my coat through.
Quiet chewing, over and over.
The folds of my neck sway gently.

lines.zh: 有虫落在鼻子上，我甩头
lines.en: A bug lands on my nose and I shake it off.
I lift my eyes and look you over.

lines.zh: 你就是那个走来走去的
lines.en: You're the one who keeps walking about.
My nose comes close to your hand.
You smell faintly of grass.
I'm not afraid of people, nor fond.
Head tilted at the bucket you carry.
I blink one wet, patient eye.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出低沉的一声
lines.en: A low sound rolls in my throat.
I shift to stand downwind of you.
Seen enough. Back to the grass.
Ears forward, listening to your voice.
I take one slow step toward you.
A low moo, and I back away.
That struck my shoulder blade.
Every herdmate lifts its head.
I shake my head. It stings.
I shrink back into the herd.
Thick hide, but it still hurts.
Blood seeps slowly through my coat.
I take two ragged breaths.
I don't want a fight. I want to leave.
That blow I'll remember.
Is that wheat? I'll take either.
That smell is faintly sweet.
My nose arrives before the rest of me.
Grass or grain, it's all the same to me.
More, please. I'm not full yet.
What's in your hand smells better.
A herdmate is crowding in too.
I sniff first, then decide.
This mouthful crunches nicely.
Walk slowly and I'll keep up.
Don't hold the bucket so high.
There'll be more after this, right?
My tongue sweeps up a mouthful.
Bits of it cling to my muzzle.
For that, I'll walk a few more steps.
It smells like something safe.
You bumped my belly.
This body doesn't move easily.
Move over. I'm not done eating.
My tail swept you by accident.
Hooves planted. Don't push.
Bump me and I simply stop.
I give half a step.
That's nothing at all.
A herdmate glances this way.
Take it easy. No rush.
I rest my head against her neck.
We graze the same patch of grass.
My tail taps hers, lightly.
She walks, and I follow.
What color will the calf be, I wonder.
I nudge her with my nose.
We stand together doing nothing.
She lows softly. I answer.
We share the same fence line.
Quiet days last the longest.
I lower my head and tear up a mouthful.
My tongue curls it into my mouth.
Chewing, then a slow swallow.
This mouthful is a bit sandy.
I'll drop it and come back later.
I sniff it before I commit.
Mouth full, and still looking for more.
I let a herdmate have half.
A stem pokes out of my muzzle.
Not elegant. But honest work.
Something's coming over.
I look up and stop grazing.
A herdmate lifts its head too.
Your footsteps are too heavy.
I drift toward the herd.
The herd slowly gathers into a knot.
I don't bolt. I watch.
Every ear is up now.
My nostrils puff a white breath.
I dare not take this step.
Watching you without blinking.
The herd shifts back one step.
I stand in front of the calf.
I turn my body slowly aside.
We've trampled the grass to chaos.
Come closer, and we move off.

lines.zh: 我在掂量你有没有威胁
lines.en: I'm weighing whether you're a threat.
I lower my head, horn tips toward you.
My breathing thickens a little.
One more step and we run.
I butt you away with my head.

lines.zh: 前蹄抬了一下，没踩下去
lines.en: My forehoof lifts, then doesn't fall.
My tail slaps your leg.
I turn broadside and block the way.
My horn sweeps out, pulled short.
I shove past you and run to the herd.
My horn grazes past your hand.
I never meant to hurt you.
My hooves kick up a spray of dirt.
After the shove, I back away.

lines.zh: 草丛里走出一头奶油色的牛
lines.en: A cream-colored cow steps from the grass.
My hooves land first, steady.
I take in the open plain.
Sunlight warms my back.
The wind carries green grass smell.
I lower my head for a first bite.
Another cow calls in the distance.
I let out a gentle moo.

lines.zh: 蹄印在软土上留得很深
lines.en: My prints sink deep in the soft earth.
Tender grass here. Good.
My coat singes, and the smell is sharp.
I fall and all four legs go weak.
Water fills my nose and I thrash.
The blast knocks me sideways.
Something pierces my flank.
A chill runs through my bones.
Too hungry even to chew my cud.
Lightning jolts all four of my legs.
The ground under me is gone.
